description: This file contains unit tests for timer functionalities and watchdog mechanisms within the WPEFramework, utilizing Google Test framework. It defines classes for handling timers and watchdogs, and includes multiple test cases for timer scheduling, past time handling, and watchdog behavior.

classes.name: TimeHandler
classes.description: Handles timing events, tracks the number of times a timer callback is invoked, and synchronizes via mutex and condition variable.

classes.name: WatchDogHandler
classes.description: Implements a watchdog timer that can be started, expired, and waited upon, using Core::WatchDogType and Core::Event.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Returns the scheduled time in ticks or 0 if already done.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the timer callback has been invoked.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the watchdog timer with a specified delay.

methods.name: Expired
methods.description: Handles the expiration event of the watchdog.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the watchdog event to be signaled.
